parameters.name: All
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to delete all tags. This parameter is valid only when the **TagKey.N**parameter is not specified. Default value: false. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false**

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the resource. Tags are bound to API groups, plug-ins, and applications. You can use tags to manage cloud resources by group. Valid values:

*   **apiGroup**
*   **plugin**
*   **app**

parameters.name: TagKey
parameters.description: The tag keys of the resource.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi untag-resources --resource-type apiGroup --all true --resource-id example-string --tag-key example-string --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi UntagResources --region cn-hangzhou --All true --ResourceId.1 'example-string' --TagKey.1 'example-string' --ResourceType apiGroup
